text:
Ibtida-e-Wahi:
Hazrat Jabir se Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein marwi hai ke sab se pehle Quran-e-Kareem ki yehi ayat (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ ۙ) (Al-Muddaththir: 1) nazil hui hai, lekin jamhoor ka qaul yeh hai ke sab se pehli wahi Ayat-e-Iqra ki aayatein hain jaise isi surat ki tafsir ke mauqe par aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Yahya bin Abi Katheer farmate hain maine Hazrat Abu Salamah bin Abdur Rahman se sawal kiya ke sab se pehle Quran-e-Kareem ki konsi aayatein nazil huin? To farmaya ayat (Ya Aiyuhal Muddaththir). Maine kaha log to ayat (اِقْرَاْ باسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ ۚ) (Al-Alaq: 1) batate hain, farmaya maine Hazrat Jabir se poochha tha unhone wahi jawab diya jo maine tumhe diya aur maine bhi wahi kaha jo tumne mujhe kaha, uske jawab mein Hazrat Jabir ne farmaya ke main to tumse wahi kehta hoon jo humse Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya ke main Hira mein Allah ki yaad se jab farigh hua aur utra to maine suna ke goya mujhe koi aawaz de raha hai, maine apne aage peechhe daayein baayein dekha magar koi nazar na aaya, to maine sar utha kar upar ko dekha to aawaz dene wala nazar aaya. Main Khadija (R.A) ke paas aaya aur kaha mujhe chadar urha do aur mujh par thanda pani dalo, unhone aisa hi kiya aur ayat (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ ۙ) (Al-Muddaththir: 1) ki aayatein utrin (Bukhari).

Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne wahi ke ruk jaane ki hadis bayan farmate hue farmaya ke ek martba main chala ja raha tha ke nagahan aasmaan ki taraf se mujhe aawaz sunai di. Maine nigah utha kar dekha ke jo farishta mere paas Ghar-e-Hira mein aaya tha woh aasmaan o zameen ke darmiyan ek kursi par baitha hai, main maare darr aur ghabrahat ke zameen ki taraf jhuk gaya aur ghar aate hi kaha ke mujhe kapron se dhank do, chunacha ghar walon ne mujhe kapre orha diye aur Surah Muddaththir ki (وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ ۽) (Al-Muddaththir: 5) tak ki aayatein utrin, Abu Salamah farmate hain (Rujz) se murad buton hain.

Phir wahi barabar tabar-tod garma-garmi se aane lagi, yeh lafz Bukhari ke hain aur yahi siyaq mehfooz hai is se saaf pata chalta hai ke is se pehle bhi koi wahi aayi thi kyunke aap ka farman mojood hai ke yeh wahi tha jo Ghar-e-Hira mein mere paas aaya tha yaani Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) jabke ghar mein Surah Iqra ki aayatein (ma lam ya'lam) tak parha gaye thay, phir us ke baad wahi kuch zamaana tak na aayi phir jo is ki aamad shuru hui us mein sab se pehle wahi Surah Muddassir ki ibtidai aayatein thin aur is tarah un dono ahadees mein tatbeeq bhi hojati hai ke darasal sab se pehle wahi to Iqra ki aayatein hain phir wahi ke ruk jaane ke baad ki is se pehli wahi is soorat ki aayatein hain is ki taajeed Musnad Ahmad waghera ki ahadees se bhi hoti hai jin mein hai ke wahi ruk jaane ke baad ki pehli wahi is ki ibtidai aayatein hain, Tabarani mein is soorat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh marwi hai ke Waleed bin Mughira ne Quraishiyon ki dawat ki jab sab khaa pi chuke toh kehne laga batao tum is shakhs ki baabat kya kehte ho? To baaz ne kaha jadugar hai baaz ne kaha nahi hai, baaz ne kaha kahin hai kisi ne kaha kahin nahi hai, baaz ne kaha shaayar hai baaz ne kaha shaayar nahi hai, baaz ne kaha is ka yeh kalaam yaani Quran manqool jadoo hai chunacha is par ijmaa ho gaya ke isay manqool jadoo kaha jaye. Huzoor ﷺ ko jab yeh itlaah pahunchi toh ghamgeen hue aur sar par kapra daal liya aur kapra odh bhi liya jis par yeh aayatein (fa sabir) tak utreen. Phir farmaya hai ke khade ho jao, yaani azm aur qawi iraday ke sath kamar-basta aur tayyar ho jao aur logon ko hamari zaat se, jahannam se, aur un ke bad-aamal ki saza se darao. Un ko aagah kar do un ko ghaflat ko door kar do, pehli wahi se nabuwat ke sath Huzoor ﷺ ko mumtaz kiya gaya aur is wahi se aap rasool banaye gaye aur apne Rabb hi ki taazeem karo aur apne kapron ko paak rakho yaani maseeyat, bad-ahdi, wada-shikni waghera se bachte raho, jaise ke shaayar ke sher mein hai ke bihamdillah main fisq-o-fujoor ke libas se aur ghadr ke roomal se aari hoon, arabi muhawaray mein yeh barabar aata hai ke kapre paak rakho yaani gunah chhod do, aamal ki islaah kar lo, yeh bhi matlab kaha gaya hai ke darasal aap na toh kahin hain na jadugar hain yeh log kuch hi kaha karein aap parwah bhi na karein, arabi muhawaray mein jo maseeyat-alood, bad-ahad ho usay maile aur gandey kapron wala aur jo ismat-maab, paband-e-wada ho usay paak kapron wala kehte hain, shaayar kehta hai:
Iza al-mar'u lam yudnas minal-lumi 'irduhu fa kullu rida'in yartadihu jameel
Yaani insan jabke siyah-kariyon se alag hai toh har kapre mein woh haseen hai aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke ghair zaroori libas na pehno apne kapron ko maseeyat-alood na karo. Kapre paak saaf rakho, mailon ko dho dala karo, mushrikon ki tarah apna libas na paak na rakho. Darasal yeh sab matlab theek hain yeh bhi woh bhi.

Saath hi dil bhi paak ho, dil par bhi kapre ka itlaaq kalaam-e-Arab mein paya jata hai, jaise Imra-ul-Qais ke shaer mein hai aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H se is ayat ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke apne dil ko aur apni niyat ko saaf rakho. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qarzi aur Hasan R.H se yeh bhi marwi hai ke apne akhlaq ko acha rakho. Gandagi ko chor do yani buton ko aur Allah ki nafarmani chor do, jaise aur jagah farmaan hai (Ya Ayyuhan-Nabiyyuttaqillaha wa la tuti'il-kafirina wal-munafiqin, innAllaha kana 'aliman hakima) [Surah Al-Ahzab: 1]. Ae Nabi! Allah se daro aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki na mano. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Hazrat Harun Alaihis Salam se farmaya tha, "Ae Harun! Mere baad meri kaum mein tum meri jaan-sishini karo, islaah ke darpey raho aur mufsidon ki raah ikhtiyar na karo."

Phir farmata hai, "Atiya dekar ziyadati ke khwahaan na raho." Ibn Mas'ud ki qiraat mein ayat (An tastaksir) hai. Yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke apne naik aamal ka ehsaan Allah par rakhte hue had se zyada tang na karo aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke talab-e-khair mein ghaflat na barto aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke apni nubuwwat ka baar-e-ehsaan logon par rakh kar is ke عوض duniya talabi na karo. Yeh chaar qaul hue, lekin awwal awla hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farmata hai, "Un ki eza par jo raah-e-Allah mein tujhe pohnche, toh Rab ki raza-mandi ki khatir sabr-o-zabt kar." Allah Ta'ala ne jo tujhe mansab diya hai, us par laga reh aur jama reh. (Naqoor) se murad Soor hai. Musnad Ahmad, Ibn Abi Hatim waghaira mein hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Main kaise rahat se rahoon? Halankke soor wale farishte ne apne munh mein soor le rakha hai aur peshani jhukaye hue hukm-e-Allah ka muntazir hai ke kab hukm ho aur woh soor phoonk de." Ashaab-e-Rasool ﷺ ne kaha, "Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Phir hamein kya irshad hota hai?" Farmaya, "Kaho dua (Hasb-un-Allahu wa ni'mal-wakeel, 'alal-lahi tawakkalna)."

Pas soor ke phonke jaane ka zikr kar ke yeh farma kar jab soor phonka jayega, phir farmata hai ke woh din aur woh waqt kafiron par bara sakht hoga jo kisi tarah aasaan na hoga, jaise aur jagah khud kuffar ka qaul marwi hai ke ayat (Fa zalika yauma'izin yawmun 'asir) [Surah Al-Muddaththir: 9], "Yeh aaj ka din toh behad garan-baar aur sakht mushkil ka din hai."

Hazrat Zurarah bin Awfi R.H jo Basre ke qazi thay, woh ek martaba apne muqtadiyon ko subh ki namaz parha rahe thay, isi surat ki tilawat thi, jab is ayat par pohnche toh besakhta zor ki ek cheekh munh se nikal gayi aur gir pare, logon ne dekha rooh parwaz ho chuki thi. Allah Ta'ala un par apni rehmat nazil farmaye.

Iza al-mar'u lam yudnas minal-lumi 'irduhu fa kullu rida'in yartadihu jameel
Yaani insan jabke siyah-kariyon se alag hai toh har kapre mein woh haseen hai aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke ghair zaroori libas na pehno apne kapron ko maseeyat-alood na karo. Pas soor ke phonke jaane ka zikr kar ke yeh farma kar jab soor phonka jayega, phir farmata hai ke woh din aur woh waqt kafiron par bara sakht hoga jo kisi tarah aasaan na hoga, jaise aur jagah khud kuffar ka qaul marwi hai ke ayat (Fa zalika yauma'izin yawmun 'asir) [Surah Al-Muddaththir: 9], "Yeh aaj ka din toh behad garan-baar aur sakht mushkil ka din hai."

Maine kaha log to ayat (اِقْرَاْ باسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ ۚ) (Al-Alaq: 1) batate hain, farmaya maine Hazrat Jabir se poochha tha unhone wahi jawab diya jo maine tumhe diya aur maine bhi wahi kaha jo tumne mujhe kaha, uske jawab mein Hazrat Jabir ne farmaya ke main to tumse wahi kehta hoon jo humse Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya ke main Hira mein Allah ki yaad se jab farigh hua aur utra to maine suna ke goya mujhe koi aawaz de raha hai, maine apne aage peechhe daayein baayein dekha magar koi nazar na aaya, to maine sar utha kar upar ko dekha to aawaz dene wala nazar aaya. Main Khadija (R.A) ke paas aaya aur kaha mujhe chadar urha do aur mujh par thanda pani dalo, unhone aisa hi kiya aur ayat (يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ ۙ) (Al-Muddaththir: 1) ki aayatein utrin (Bukhari).

Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne wahi ke ruk jaane ki hadis bayan farmate hue farmaya ke ek martba main chala ja raha tha ke nagahan aasmaan ki taraf se mujhe aawaz sunai di. Maine nigah utha kar dekha ke jo farishta mere paas Ghar-e-Hira mein aaya tha woh aasmaan o zameen ke darmiyan ek kursi par baitha hai, main maare darr aur ghabrahat ke zameen ki taraf jhuk gaya aur ghar aate hi kaha ke mujhe kapron se dhank do, chunacha ghar walon ne mujhe kapre orha diye aur Surah Muddaththir ki (وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ ۽) (Al-Muddaththir: 5) tak ki aayatein utrin, Abu Salamah farmate hain (Rujz) se murad buton hain.

Phir wahi barabar tabar-tod garma-garmi se aane lagi, yeh lafz Bukhari ke hain aur yahi siyaq mehfooz hai is se saaf pata chalta hai ke is se pehle bhi koi wahi aayi thi kyunke aap ka farman mojood hai ke yeh wahi tha jo Ghar-e-Hira mein mere paas aaya tha yaani Hazrat Jibrail (Alaihis Salam) jabke ghar mein Surah Iqra ki aayatein (ma lam ya'lam) tak parha gaye thay, phir us ke baad wahi kuch zamaana tak na aayi phir jo is ki aamad shuru hui us mein sab se pehle wahi Surah Muddassir ki ibtidai aayatein thin aur is tarah un dono ahadees mein tatbeeq bhi hojati hai ke darasal sab se pehle wahi to Iqra ki aayatein hain phir wahi ke ruk jaane ke baad ki is se pehli wahi is soorat ki aayatein hain is ki taajeed Musnad Ahmad waghera ki ahadees se bhi hoti hai jin mein hai ke wahi ruk jaane ke baad ki pehli wahi is ki ibtidai aayatein hain, Tabarani mein is soorat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh marwi hai ke Waleed bin Mughira ne Quraishiyon ki dawat ki jab sab khaa pi chuke toh kehne laga batao tum is shakhs ki baabat kya kehte ho? To baaz ne kaha jadugar hai baaz ne kaha nahi hai, baaz ne kaha kahin hai kisi ne kaha kahin nahi hai, baaz ne kaha shaayar hai baaz ne kaha shaayar nahi hai, baaz ne kaha is ka yeh kalaam yaani Quran manqool jadoo hai chunacha is par ijmaa ho gaya ke isay manqool jadoo kaha jaye. Huzoor ﷺ ko jab yeh itlaah pahunchi toh ghamgeen hue aur sar par kapra daal liya aur kapra odh bhi liya jis par yeh aayatein (fa sabir) tak utreen. Phir farmaya hai ke khade ho jao, yaani azm aur qawi iraday ke sath kamar-basta aur tayyar ho jao aur logon ko hamari zaat se, jahannam se, aur un ke bad-aamal ki saza se darao. Un ko aagah kar do un ko ghaflat ko door kar do, pehli wahi se nabuwat ke sath Huzoor ﷺ ko mumtaz kiya gaya aur is wahi se aap rasool banaye gaye aur apne Rabb hi ki taazeem karo aur apne kapron ko paak rakho yaani maseeyat, bad-ahdi, wada-shikni waghera se bachte raho, jaise ke shaayar ke sher mein hai ke bihamdillah main fisq-o-fujoor ke libas se aur ghadr ke roomal se aari hoon, arabi muhawaray mein yeh barabar aata hai ke kapre paak rakho yaani gunah chhod do, aamal ki islaah kar lo, yeh bhi matlab kaha gaya hai ke darasal aap na toh kahin hain na jadugar hain yeh log kuch hi kaha karein aap parwah bhi na karein, arabi muhawaray mein jo maseeyat-alood, bad-ahad ho usay maile aur gandey kapron wala aur jo ismat-maab, paband-e-wada ho usay paak kapron wala kehte hain, shaayar kehta hai:
Iza al-mar'u lam yudnas minal-lumi 'irduhu fa kullu rida'in yartadihu jameel
Yaani insan jabke siyah-kariyon se alag hai toh har kapre mein woh haseen hai aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke ghair zaroori libas na pehno apne kapron ko maseeyat-alood na karo. Kapre paak saaf rakho, mailon ko dho dala karo, mushrikon ki tarah apna libas na paak na rakho. Darasal yeh sab matlab theek hain yeh bhi woh bhi.

Saath hi dil bhi paak ho, dil par bhi kapre ka itlaaq kalaam-e-Arab mein paya jata hai, jaise Imra-ul-Qais ke shaer mein hai aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H se is ayat ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke apne dil ko aur apni niyat ko saaf rakho. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qarzi aur Hasan R.H se yeh bhi marwi hai ke apne akhlaq ko acha rakho. Gandagi ko chor do yani buton ko aur Allah ki nafarmani chor do, jaise aur jagah farmaan hai (Ya Ayyuhan-Nabiyyuttaqillaha wa la tuti'il-kafirina wal-munafiqin, innAllaha kana 'aliman hakima) [Surah Al-Ahzab: 1]. Ae Nabi! Allah se daro aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki na mano. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Hazrat Harun Alaihis Salam se farmaya tha, "Ae Harun! Mere baad meri kaum mein tum meri jaan-sishini karo, islaah ke darpey raho aur mufsidon ki raah ikhtiyar na karo."

Phir farmata hai, "Atiya dekar ziyadati ke khwahaan na raho." Ibn Mas'ud ki qiraat mein ayat (An tastaksir) hai. Yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke apne naik aamal ka ehsaan Allah par rakhte hue had se zyada tang na karo aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke talab-e-khair mein ghaflat na barto aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke apni nubuwwat ka baar-e-ehsaan logon par rakh kar is ke عوض duniya talabi na karo. Yeh chaar qaul hue, lekin awwal awla hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farmata hai, "Un ki eza par jo raah-e-Allah mein tujhe pohnche, toh Rab ki raza-mandi ki khatir sabr-o-zabt kar." Allah Ta'ala ne jo tujhe mansab diya hai, us par laga reh aur jama reh. (Naqoor) se murad Soor hai. Musnad Ahmad, Ibn Abi Hatim waghaira mein hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Main kaise rahat se rahoon? Halankke soor wale farishte ne apne munh mein soor le rakha hai aur peshani jhukaye hue hukm-e-Allah ka muntazir hai ke kab hukm ho aur woh soor phoonk de." Ashaab-e-Rasool ﷺ ne kaha, "Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Phir hamein kya irshad hota hai?" Farmaya, "Kaho dua (Hasb-un-Allahu wa ni'mal-wakeel, 'alal-lahi tawakkalna)."

Pas soor ke phonke jaane ka zikr kar ke yeh farma kar jab soor phonka jayega, phir farmata hai ke woh din aur woh waqt kafiron par bara sakht hoga jo kisi tarah aasaan na hoga, jaise aur jagah khud kuffar ka qaul marwi hai ke ayat (Fa zalika yauma'izin yawmun 'asir) [Surah Al-Muddaththir: 9], "Yeh aaj ka din toh behad garan-baar aur sakht mushkil ka din hai."

Hazrat Zurarah bin Awfi R.H jo Basre ke qazi thay, woh ek martaba apne muqtadiyon ko subh ki namaz parha rahe thay, isi surat ki tilawat thi, jab is ayat par pohnche toh besakhta zor ki ek cheekh munh se nikal gayi aur gir pare, logon ne dekha rooh parwaz ho chuki thi. Allah Ta'ala un par apni rehmat nazil farmaye.

Yaani insan jabke siyah-kariyon se alag hai toh har kapre mein woh haseen hai aur yeh matlab bhi hai ke ghair zaroori libas na pehno apne kapron ko maseeyat-alood na karo. Kapre paak saaf rakho, mailon ko dho dala karo, mushrikon ki tarah apna libas na paak na rakho. Darasal yeh sab matlab theek hain yeh bhi woh bhi.

Saath hi dil bhi paak ho, dil par bhi kapre ka itlaaq kalaam-e-Arab mein paya jata hai, jaise Imra-ul-Qais ke shaer mein hai aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H se is ayat ki tafsir mein marwi hai ke apne dil ko aur apni niyat ko saaf rakho. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qarzi aur Hasan R.H se yeh bhi marwi hai ke apne akhlaq ko acha rakho. Gandagi ko chor do yani buton ko aur Allah ki nafarmani chor do, jaise aur jagah farmaan hai (Ya Ayyuhan-Nabiyyuttaqillaha wa la tuti'il-kafirina wal-munafiqin, innAllaha kana 'aliman hakima) [Surah Al-Ahzab: 1]. Ae Nabi! Allah se daro aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki na mano. Hazrat Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Hazrat Harun Alaihis Salam se farmaya tha, "Ae Harun! Mere baad meri kaum mein tum meri jaan-sishini karo, islaah ke darpey raho aur mufsidon ki raah ikhtiyar na karo."

Phir farmata hai, "Atiya dekar ziyadati ke khwahaan na raho." Ibn Mas'ud ki qiraat mein ayat (An tastaksir) hai. Yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke apne naik aamal ka ehsaan Allah par rakhte hue had se zyada tang na karo aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke talab-e-khair mein ghaflat na barto aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke apni nubuwwat ka baar-e-ehsaan logon par rakh kar is ke عوض duniya talabi na karo. Yeh chaar qaul hue, lekin awwal awla hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Phir farmata hai, "Un ki eza par jo raah-e-Allah mein tujhe pohnche, toh Rab ki raza-mandi ki khatir sabr-o-zabt kar." Allah Ta'ala ne jo tujhe mansab diya hai, us par laga reh aur jama reh. Pas soor ke phonke jaane ka zikr kar ke yeh farma kar jab soor phonka jayega, phir farmata hai ke woh din aur woh waqt kafiron par bara sakht hoga jo kisi tarah aasaan na hoga, jaise aur jagah khud kuffar ka qaul marwi hai ke ayat (Fa zalika yauma'izin yawmun 'asir) [Surah Al-Muddaththir: 9], "Yeh aaj ka din toh behad garan-baar aur sakht mushkil ka din hai."

Hazrat Zurarah bin Awfi R.H jo Basre ke qazi thay, woh ek martaba apne muqtadiyon ko subh ki namaz parha rahe thay, isi surat ki tilawat thi, jab is ayat par pohnche toh besakhta zor ki ek cheekh munh se nikal gayi aur gir pare, logon ne dekha rooh parwaz ho chuki thi. Allah Ta'ala un par apni rehmat nazil farmaye.

Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. Tumhein khoob maloom hai ke jinnaat aur insan ka kalam mujhe khoob yaad hai main khud nami shair hoon kalam ke husn-o-qubah se khoob waqif hoon lekin Allah ki qasam Muhammad ﷺ ka kalam is mein se kuch bhi nahi Allah janta hai is mein ajab halawat mithaas lazzat shiftagi aur daleeri hai woh tamam kalamon ke sardar hai is ke samne aur koi kalam jachta nahi woh sab par cha jata hai is mein kashish bulandi aur jazab hai ab tum hi batao ke main is kalam ki nisbat kya kahun? Abu Jahl ne kaha suno jab tak tum ise burai ke sath yaad na karoge tumhari قوم ke khayalaat tumhari nisbat saaf nahi honge, us ne kaha acha toh mujhe mohlat do main soch kar is ki nisbat koi aisa kalma keh doon ga chunacha soch soch kar qaumi hamiyat aur naak rakhne ki khatir us ne keh diya ke yeh toh jadoo hai jise woh naqal karta hai is par ayat (Zarnee min khalqee wa ja'altu lahu malam mamdooda...) se (Sa-uslihu saqar) tak ki aaytein utrin.

Suddi kehte hain ke Dar-un-Nadwa mein baith kar un sab logon ne mashwara kiya ke mausam-e-hajj par charon taraf se log aayenge toh batao unhein Muhammad ﷺ ki nisbat kya kahen? Koi aisi tajweez karo ke sab yak zaban wahi baat kahein taake Arab bhar mein aur phir har jagah bhi wahi mashhoor ho jaye toh ab kisi ne shair kaha kisi ne jadugar kaha kisi ne kahin aur najoomi kaha kisi ne majnoon aur deewana kaha Walid baitha sochta raha aur ghor-o-fikr kar ke dekh bhal kar teyori charha aur munh bana kar kehne laga jadugaron ka qoul hai jise yeh naqal kar raha hai, Quran Kareem mein aur jagah hai ayat (Unzur kaifa daraboo lakal-amsaala fadalloo fala yastateoona sabeela) (Al-Isra: 48) yani zara dekh to sahi teri kaisi kaisi misalein gharte hain lekin bahak bahak kar reh jate hain aur kisi nateeje tak nahi pahunch sakte.

Ab is ki saza ka zikr ho raha hai ke main unhein Jahannam ki aag mein gharq kar dunga jo zabardast khofnak azab ki aag hai jo gosht post ko rag pathon ko kha jaati hai phir yeh sab taza paida kiye jaate hain aur phir zinda kiye jaate hain na maut aaye na rahat wali zindagi mile, khaal udhed dene wali woh aag hai ek hi lapak mein jism ko raat se zyada siyah kar deti hai, woh jism-o-jild ko bhun bhulas deti hai, unis unis daroghe is par muqarrar hain jo na thakein na raham karein, Hazrat Bara' R.H (Razi Allahu Anhu) se marwi hai ke chand yahudiyon ne sahaba se yeh waqiya bayan kiya usi waqt aayat (Alaiha tis'ata 'ashar) [74. Al-Muddaththir: 30] nazil hui Aap ﷺ ne sahaba ko suna di aur kaha zara unhein mere paas to lao main bhi un se puchun ke Jannat ki mitti kya hai? Suno woh safed maida ki tarah hai, phir yahudi Aap ﷺ ke paas aaye aur Aap ﷺ se pucha ke Jahannam ke daroghon ki tadad kitni hai? Aap ﷺ ne dono haathon ki ungliyan do dafa jhukaiin dusri dafa mein anghutha rok liya yaani unis. Phir farmaya tum batlao ke Jannat ki mitti kya hai? Unhon ne Ibn Salam se kahin, Aap hi kahiye, Ibn Salam ne kaha goya woh safed roti hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yaad rakho yeh safed roti woh jo khalis maide ki ho (Ibn Abi Hatim). Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke jis shakhs ne Huzoor ﷺ ko sahaba ke lajawab hone ki khabar di thi us ne aa kar kaha tha ke aaj to aap ke ashab haar gaye, pucha kaise? Us ne kaha un se jawab na ban pada aur kehna pada ke hum apne Nabi ﷺ se puch lenge, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya bhala woh haare hue kaise kahe ja sakte hain? In yahudiyon ko dushmanan-e-Ilahi ko zara mere paas to lao, haan, unhon ne apne Nabi se Allah ko dekhne ka sawal kiya tha aur un par azab bheja gaya tha. Ab yehud bulwaye gaye, jawab diya gaya aur Huzoor ﷺ ke sawal par yeh bade chakraye, ek dusre ki taraf dekhne lage.

Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. Jis khabees shakhs ne Allah ki naimaton ka kufr kiya aur Quran ko insani qaul kaha us ki sazaon ka zikr ho raha hai, pehle jo naimatein us par inam hui hain un ka bayan ho raha hai ki yeh tan tanah khali hath duniya mein aaya tha maal-o-aulad diya aur kuch us ke paas na tha phir Allah ne use maldar banadiya, hazaron lakhon dinar zar zameen waghera inayat farmai aur ba-aitibar ba'az aqwal ke terah aur ba'az aqwal ke das larke diye jo sab ke sab us ke paas baithe rehte thay naukar chakar laundi ghulam kam kaj karte rehte aur yeh maze se apni zindagi apni aulad ke sath guzarta, gharz dhan daulat laundi ghulam bal bachay aaram aasayish har tarah ki muhayya thi, phir bhi khwahish-e-nafs poori nahi hoti thi aur chahta tha ki Allah aur barha de, halanki aisa ab na hoga, yeh hamare ahkaamat ke ilm ke baad bhi kufr aur sarkashi karta hai ise Sa'ood par charhaya jayega, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ki Wail Jahannam ki ek wadi ka naam hai jis mein kafir giraya jayega chalis saal tak andar hi andar jata rahega lekin phir bhi teh tak na pahuchega aur Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek nari pahaad ka naam hai jis par kafir ko charhaya jayega sattar saal tak to charta hi rahega phir wahan se niche gira diya jayega sattar saal tak niche ludhakta rahega aur isi abdi saza mein giraftar rahega, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (Rahimahullah) ise ghareeb kehte hain, sath hi yeh hadith munkar hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Sa'ood Jahannam ke ek pahaad ka naam hai jo aag ka hai ise majboor kiya jayega is par charhe hath rakhte hi rakhte rakh ho jayega aur uthate hi badastoor waisa hi ho jayega isi tarah paon bhi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Jahannam ki ek chattan ka naam hai jis par kafir apne munh ke bal ghaseeta jayega, Suddi kehte hain yeh patthar bara phislna hai, Mujahid kehte hain matlab ayat ka yeh hai ki hum use mashaqqat wala azab denge, Qatada farmate hain aisa azab jis mein aur jis se kabhi bhi rahat na ho, Imam Jareer isi ko pasand farmate hain.

Phir farmata hai ki hum ne us takleef-deh azaab se is liye qareeb kardiya ki woh iman se bahut door tha woh soch soch kar khud-sakhta duniya mein rehta tha ki woh Quran ki manand kahe aur baat banaye phir us par afsos kiya jata hai aur muhawara-e-arab ke mutabiq us ke halakat ke kalme kahe jate hain ki yeh gharat kardiya jaye yeh barbad kardiya jaye kitna bad-kalam, buri soch, kitni behayai se jhoot baat ghad li, aur baar baar ghor-o-fikr ke baad peshani par bal daal kar, munh bigaad kar, haq se hat kar bhalayi se munh mod kar itaat-e-allah se munh pher kar, dil kada kar ke keh diya ki yeh Quran Allah ka kalam nahi balki Muhammad ﷺ apne se pehle logon ka jadoo ka mantar naqal karliya karte hain aur usi ko suna rahe hain yeh kalam Allah ka nahi balki insani qoul hai aur jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us maloon ka naam Waleed bin Mugheera Makhzoomi tha, Quraish ka sardar tha, Hazrat Ibn Abbas ؓ farmate hain waqiya yeh hai ki ek martaba yeh Waleed paleed Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique ؓ ke paas aaya aur khwahish zahir ki ki aap kuch Quran sunaye Hazrat Siddique Akbar ne chand aayatein padh sunayin jo us ke dil mein ghar kar gayin jab yahan se nikla aur kuffar-e-quraish ke majma mein pahuncha toh kehne laga logo! tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. (Al-Muddaththir: 11) Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain us ne kaha tha Quran ke bare mein bahut kuch ghor-o-khwoz ke baad is natije par pahuncha hoon ki yeh sher toh nahi us mein halawat hai, us mein chamak hai, yeh ghalib hai maghloob nahi lekin hai yaqinan jadoo. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Kaha is liye ke aap ko deen aur Muhammad ﷺ ke paas aap ka jana churwayen kyunki aap wahan maal hasil karne ki gharz se hi jate aate hain us ne ghussa mein aa kar kaha meri قوم ko maloom nahi ke main un sab se zyada maldar hoon? Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh theek hai lekin us waqt toh logon ka yeh khayal pukhta ho gaya ke Muhammad ﷺ se maal hasil karne ki gharz se aap usi ke ho gaye hain agar aap chahte hain ke yeh baat logon ke dilon se uth jaye toh aap is ke bare mein kuch sakht alfaaz kahein taake logon ko yaqeen ho jaye ke aap is ke mukhalif hain aur aap ko is se koi tama nahi, us ne kaha bhai baat toh yeh hai ke us ne jo Quran mujhe sunaya hai qasam hai Allah ki na woh shair hai na qaseeda hai aur na rajz hai, na jinnaat ka qoul aur na un ke ash’ar hain. tajjub ki baat hai Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Quran padhte hain Allah ki qasam na toh woh sher hai na jadoo ka mantar hai na majnoonana bad hai balki wallah woh toh khas Allah Ta'ala hi ka kalam hai us mein koi shaq nahi, Quraishiyon ne yeh sun kar sar pakad liya aur kehne lage agar yeh musalman hogaya toh bas phir Quraish mein se ek bhi bagair islam laye baaki na rahega, Abu Jahl ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi toh us ne kaha ghabrao nahi dekho main ek tarkeb se ise islam se pher doon ga yeh kehte hi apne zehen mein ek tarkeb soch kar yeh Waleed ke ghar pahuncha aur kehne laga aap ki qaam ne aap ke liye chanda kar ke bahut sa maal jama karliya hai aur woh aap ko sadqa mein dene wale hain, us ne kaha wah kya maze ki baat hai mujhe un ke chandoon aur sadqoon ki kya zaroorat hai duniya janti hai ki un sab mein mujh se zyada maal-o-aulad wala koi nahi Abu Jahl ne kaha yeh toh theek hai lekin logon mein aisi baatein ho rahi hain ki aap jo Abu Bakar ke paas aate jate hain woh sirf is liye ki un se kuch hasil wasool ho, Waleed kehne laga oho mere khandan mein meri nisbat yeh cha-migoiyan ho rahi hain mujhe mutlaq maloom na tha acha ab qasam Allah ki na main Abu Bakar ke paas jaoon na Umar ke paas na Rasool ﷺ ke paas aur woh jo kuch kehte hain woh sirf jadoo hai jo naqal kiya jata hai, us par Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayatein nazil farmayin yaani ayat (ZARNI WA MAN KHALAQTU WAHEEDA 11 ۙ) 74. Us par yeh aayatein utrin.

Ibn Jarir mein hai ke Walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya tha aur Quran sun kar uska dil narm par gaya tha aur poora asar ho chuka tha jab Abu Jahl ko yeh maloom hua toh dora bhaga aaya aur is dar se ke kahin yeh khullam khula musalman na ho jaye is bharkane ke liye jhoot moot kehne laga ke chacha aap ki قوم aap ke liye maal jama karna chahti hai poocha kyun? Sakht dil be-rahm farishte aur Abu Jahl

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke azab dene par aur Jahannam ki nigahbani par hum ne farishte hi muqarrar kiye hain jo sakht be-rahm aur sakht kalam karne wale hain. Is mein mushrikin-e-Quraish ki tardid hai, unhe jis waqt Jahannam ke daroghaon ki ginti batlayi gayi to Abu Jahl ne kaha: "Aiye Quraishiyo! Yeh agar unis hain to ziyada se ziyada ek sau nabbe, hum mil kar inhe hara denge." Is par kaha jata hai ke woh farishte hain, insan nahi; unhe na tum hara sakko ge na thaka sakko ge.
