Ek taraf kafiron ka kufr khul gaya, dusri janib Ahl-e-Kitab ka yaqeen-e-kamil ho gaya ke is Rasool ki risalat haq hai kyunke khud un ki kitab mein bhi yahi ginti hai. Tisri taraf imandar apne iman mein mazeed tawana ho gaye, Huzoor ﷺ ki baat ki tasdeeq ki aur iman badhaya. Ahl-e-Kitab aur musalmano ko koi shak-o-shubha na raha, bimar dil aur munafiq cheekh uthe ke bhala batao ke isay yahan zikr karne mein kya hikmat hai? 

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke aisi hi baatein bahut se logon ke iman ki mazbuti ka sabab ban jati hain aur bahut se logon ke shubhe wale dil aur danwa-dol ho jate hain. Allah ke yeh sab kaam hikmat se aur asrar se hain. Tere Rabb ke lashkaron ki ginti aur un ki sahi tadad aur un ki kasrat ka kisi ko ilm nahi, wahi khoob janta hai. Yeh na samajh lena ke bas unis hi hain, jaise yunani falsafiyon aur un ke ham-khayal logon ne apni jahalat-o-zalalat ki wajah se samajh liya ke is se murad uqool-e-ashra aur nufoos-e-tas'ah hain, halanki yeh mujarrad un ka dawa hai jis par daleel qayam karne se woh bilkul aajiz hain. Afsos ke aayat ke awwal par to un ki nazrein hain lekin akhri hisse ke sath woh kufr kar rahe hain jahan saf alfaz mojood hain ke tere Rabb ke lashkaron ko us ke siwa koi nahi janta, phir sirf unis ke kya ma'ni?

Bukhari o Muslim ki Mairaj wali hadith mein sabit hochuka hai ke An-Hazoor ﷺ ne Bait-ul-Ma'moor ka ausaf bayan karte hue farmaya ke woh satwein aasman par hai aur us mein har roz sattar hazaar farishte jaate hain, isi tarah doosre roz doosre sattar hazaar farishte, isi tarah hamesha tak lekin farishton ki tadad is qadar kaseer hai ke jo aaj gaye un ki baari phir Qayamat tak nahi aane ki.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Rasool-e-Maqbul ﷺ farmate hain: Main woh dekhta hoon jo tum nahi dekhte aur woh sunta hoon jo tum nahi sunte; aasmaan charchara rahe hain aur unhein charchrane ka haq hai. Ek ungli tikane ki jagah aisi khali nahi jahan koi na koi farishta sajde mein na pada ho. Agar tum woh jaan lete jo main jaanta hoon, tum bohat kam hanste, bohat zyada rote aur bistaron par apni biwiyon ke sath lazzat na pa sakte, balke faryad-o-zari karte hue jangalon ki taraf nikal khade hote.

Is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazrat Abu Zar R.A ki zuban se besaakhta yeh nikal gaya: Kash ke main koi darakht hota jo kaat diya jata. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi isay Hasan Gharib batate hain aur Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se mauqoofan bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

Tabarani mein hai: Saton aasmaanon mein qadam rakhne ki balisht bhar ya hatheli jitni jagah bhi aisi nahi jahan koi na koi farishta qiyam ki ya ruku ki ya sajde ki halat mein na ho, phir bhi yeh sab kul Roz-e-Qayamat ke din kahenge ke Allah tu paak hai, humein jis qadar teri ibadat karni chahiye thi us qadar hum se ada nahi ho sakti, albatta hum ne tere sath kisi ko shareek nahi kiya.

Imam Muhammad bin Nasr Marwazi ki kitab "As-Salah" mein hai ke An-Hazoor ﷺ ne ek martaba Sahaba se sawal kiya ke kya jo main sun raha hoon tum bhi sun rahe ho? Unhon ne jawab mein kaha: Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ, hamein to kuch sunai nahi deta. Aap ne farmaya: Aasmaanon ka charchara bolna main sun raha hoon aur woh is charchrahat par malamat nahi kiya ja sakta, kyunke us par is qadar farishte hain ke ek balisht bhar jagah khali nahi, kahin koi ruku mein hai aur kahin koi sajde mein.

Doosri riwayat mein hai: Aasmaan-e-Dunya mein ek qadam rakhne ki jagah bhi aisi nahi jahan sajde mein ya qiyam mein koi farishta na ho. Isi liye farishton ka yeh qaul Quran-e-Kareem mein maujood hai.

Aayat: (Wa ma minna illa lahu maqamum ma'loom) (37:164).

(Al-Saffat: 164) Yani hum mein se har ek ke liye muqarrar jagah hai aur hum safein baandhne aur Allah ki tasbih bayaan karne wale hain, is hadis ka marfoo hona bahut hi ghareeb hai, doosri riwayat mein yeh qaul Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood R.A ka bayaan kiya gaya hai, ek aur sanad se yeh riwayat Hazrat Ibn Alaa bin Sa'd se bhi marfoo'an marwi hai yeh sahabi Fatah Makkah mein aur uske baad ke jihaadon mein bhi Huzoor ﷺ ke sath the R.H, lekin sanadan yeh bhi ghareeb hai ek aur bahut hi ghareeb balke sakht munkar hadis mein hai ki Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A aaye namaz khari hui thi aur teen shakhs baithe hue the jin mein ka ek Abu Hajash Laithi tha Aap ne farmaya utho Huzoor ﷺ ke sath namaz mein shamil ho jao to woh shakhs to khare ho gaye lekin Abu Jahsh kehne laga agar koi aisa shakhs aaye jo taqat-o-quwwat mein mujh se zyada ho aur mujh se kushti lare aur mujhe gira de phir mera munh mitti mein mila de to main uthoonga warna bas uth chuka, Hazrat Umar ne farmaya aur kaun aayega aa ja main tayyar hoon chunacha kushti hone lagi aur main ne use pachhara phir uske munh ko mitti mein mil diya aur itne mein Hazrat Usman bin Affan R.A aa gaye aur use mere hath se chhora diya, main bara bigra aur usi gusse ki halat mein An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua Aap ne mujhe dekhte hi farmaya Abu Hafs aaj kya baat hai ? Main ne saara waqiya keh sunaya Aap ne farmaya agar Umar is se khush hota to us par raham karta Allah ki kasam mere nazdeek to is khabees ka sar utaar leta to achha tha, yeh sunte hi Hazrat Umar yunhi wahan se uth khare hue aur uski taraf lapke. Khasi door nikal chuke the jo Huzoor ﷺ ne unhe aawaz di aur farmaya baitho sun to lo ki Allah Abu Jahsh ki namaz se bilkul beniyaz hai aasman-e-duniya mein khushoo-o-khuzoo wale beshumar farishte Allah ke samne sajde mein pare hue hain jo qayamat ko sajde se sar uthayenge aur yeh kehte hue hazir honge ki ab bhi hamare Rabb hum se teri ibadat ka haq ada nahi ho saka, isi tarah doosre aasman mein bhi yehi haal hai, Hazrat Umar ne sawal kiya ki Huzoor ﷺ unki tasbih kya hai ?

Farmaya asman-e-duniya ke farishte toh kehte hain dua (Subhana zil-mulki wal-malakut) aur dusre asman ke farishte kehte hain dua (Subhana zil-'izzati wal-jabarut) aur tisre asman ke farishte kehte hain dua (Subhanal-hayyil-lazi la yamut) Umar tu bhi apni namaz mein ise kaha karo. Hazrat Umar ne kaha ya Rasulullah ﷺ is se pehle jo parhna aap ne sikhaya hai aur jis ke parhne ko farmaya hai us ka kya hoga? Kaha kabhi yeh kaho kabhi woh parho. Pehle jo parhne ko aap ne farmaya tha woh yeh tha dua ('Auzu bi-'afwika min 'uqabika wa 'uzu bi-rizaka min sakhatika wa 'uzu bika minka jalla wajhuk) yaani Allah tere hi panah pakadta hoon aur tera chehra jalal wala hai. Aur Ishaq Marwazi jo rawi-e-hadith hai is se Hazrat Imam Bukhari ؒ riwayat karte hain aur Imam Ibn Hibban ؒ bhi unhe siqa raviyon mein ginte hain lekin Hazrat Imam Abu Dawood, Imam Nisai, Imam 'Uqaili aur Imam Darqutni unhe zaeef kehte hain, Imam Abu Hatim Razi farmate hain the toh yeh sache magar nabina ho gaye the aur kabhi kabhi talqin qabul kar liya karte the haan un ke katibon ki marwiyat sahih hain. Un se yeh bhi marwi hai ki yeh muztarib hain aur un ke ustad Abdul Malik bin Qudamah Abu Qatadah Jum'ahi mein bhi kalam hai, taajjub hai ke Imam Muhammad bin Nasr ؒ ne is hadith ko kaise riwayat kar diya? Aur na toh is par kalam kiya na is ke hal ko maloom karaya, na is ke ba'z raviyon ke za'f ko bayan kiya. Haan itna toh kiya hai ke ise dusri sanad se mursalan riwayat kar diya hai aur mursal ki do sanadein laye hain ek Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair dusri Hazrat Hasan Basri se, phir ek aur riwayat laye hain ke Hazrat 'Adi bin Artah ne Madain ki jamia masjid mein apne khutbah mein farmaya ke main ne ek sahabi se suna hai unhon ne Nabi ﷺ se ke aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke bohat se aise farishte hain jo har waqt khauf-e-Khuda se kapkapate rehte hain un ke aansu girte rehte hain aur woh un farishton par tapakte hain jo namaz mein mashghul hain aur un mein aise farishte bhi hain jo ibtida-e-duniya se ruku mein hi hain aur ba'z sajde mein hi hain qiyamat ke din apni peith aur apna sar uthayenge aur nihayat aajizi se janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz karenge ke Allah tu paak hai ham se teri ibadat ka haq ada nahi ho saka. Is hadith ki isnad mein koi haraj nahi. Phir farmata hai yeh aag jis ka wasf tum sun chuke yeh logon ke liye sarasar ba'is-e-'ibrat o nasihat hai. Phir chaand ki raat ke jaane ki subah ke roshan hone ki qasmein kha kar farmata hai ke woh aag ek zabardast aur bohat badi cheez hai, jo is darawe ko qabul kar ke haq ki raah lagna chahe lag jaye. Jo chahe is ke bawajood haq ko peith hi dikhata rahe, us se door bhagta rahe, ya ise radd karta rahe.

Jannatiyon aur dozakhiyon mein guftagu ho gi, Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ki har shakhs apne aamal mein qiyamat ke din jakra bandha hoga lekin jin ke dayen haath mein aamal-nama aaya woh jannat ke bala khano mein chain se baithe hue jahannmiyon ko badtareen azabon mein dekh kar un se poochenge ki tum yahan kaise pahunch gaye? Woh jawab denge ki hum ne na to Rab ki ibadat ki na makhlooq ke sath ehsan kiya, baghair ilm ke jo zaban par aaya bakte rahe, jahan kisi ko aitraz karte suna hum bhi sath ho gaye aur baatein banane lag gaye aur qiyamat ke din ki takzeeb hi karte rahe yahan tak ki maut aa gayi. 

Yaqeen ke maane maut ke is aayat mein bhi hain: Wa'bud Rabbaka hatta ya'tiyakal yaqeen (Al-Hijr: 99), yaani maut ke waqt tak Allah ki ibadat mein laga reh aur Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon R.A ki wafat ki nisbat hadith mein bhi yaqeen ka lafz aaya hai. Ab Allah Malik-ul-Mulk farmata hai ki aise logon ko kisi ki sifarish aur shafafa'at nafa na degi is liye ki shafa'at wahan nafi ho jati hai jahan mahal-e-shafa'at ho lekin jin ka dam hi kufr par nikla ho un ke liye shafafa'at kahan? Woh hamesha ke liye Hawiyah mein gaye. 

Phir farmaya kya baat hai ki kaunsi wajah hai ki yeh kafir teri naseehat aur dawat se munh pher rahe hain aur Quran-o-Hadith se is tarah bhag rahe hain jaise jangli gadhe shikari sher se, Farsi zaban mein jise sher kehte hain use Arabi mein Asad kehte hain aur Habshi zaban mein Q-Sorah kehte hain aur Nabti zaban mein Roya. 

Phir farmata hai yeh mushrikeen to chahte hain ki un mein ke har shakhs par alag alag kitab utre jaise aur jagah un ka maqoola hai: Hatta nu'ta mithla ma ootiya rusulullah (Al-An'am: 124), yaani jab un ke paas koi aayat aati hai to kehte hain ki hum to hargaz iman na laayenge jab tak ki woh na diye jayen jo Allah ke rasoolon ko diya gaya hai. Allah Ta'ala ko ba-khoobi ilm hai ki risalat ke qabil kaun hai? Aur yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ki hum baghair amal ke chhutkara diye jayen. 

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai darasal wajah yeh hai ki unhein aakhirat ka khauf hi nahi kyunki unhein is ka yaqeen nahi, is par iman nahi balki ise jhutlate hain to phir darte kyun? 

Phir farmaya sachi baat to yeh hai ki yeh Quran mahz naseehat-o-mau'izat hai jo chahe ibrat hasil kar le aur naseehat pakad le, jaise farmaan hai: Wa ma tasha'una illa an yasha'allahu Rabbul 'alameen (At-Takwir: 29), yaani tumhari chahatein Allah ki chahat ke tabeh hain.

Phir farmaya isi ki zat is qabil hai ki us se khauf khaya jaye aur wohi aisa hai ki har ruju karne wale ki tauba kabul farmaye, Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasul Karim ﷺ ne is ayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya ki tumhara Rabb farmata hai main is ka haqdar hu ki mujh se dara jaye aur mere sath dusra mabud na thehraya jaye jo mere sath sharik banane se bach gaya toh woh meri bakhshsh ka mustahiq ho gaya, Ibn Majah aur Nasai aur Tirmizi waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Imam Tirmizi ؒ ise Hasan Gharib kehte hain, Suhail is ka ravi qawi nahi Allah Ta'ala ke ehsan se Surah Muddassir ki tafsir bhi khatam hui, Falhamdulillah

Woh jawab denge ki hum ne na to Rab ki ibadat ki na makhlooq ke sath ehsan kiya, baghair ilm ke jo zaban par aaya bakte rahe, jahan kisi ko aitraz karte suna hum bhi sath ho gaye aur baatein banane lag gaye aur qiyamat ke din ki takzeeb hi karte rahe yahan tak ki maut aa gayi. 

Yaqeen ke maane maut ke is aayat mein bhi hain: Wa'bud Rabbaka hatta ya'tiyakal yaqeen (Al-Hijr: 99), yaani maut ke waqt tak Allah ki ibadat mein laga reh aur Hazrat Usman bin Maz'oon R.A ki wafat ki nisbat hadith mein bhi yaqeen ka lafz aaya hai. Ab Allah Malik-ul-Mulk farmata hai ki aise logon ko kisi ki sifarish aur shafafa'at nafa na degi is liye ki shafa'at wahan nafi ho jati hai jahan mahal-e-shafa'at ho lekin jin ka dam hi kufr par nikla ho un ke liye shafafa'at kahan? Woh hamesha ke liye Hawiyah mein gaye. 

Phir farmaya kya baat hai ki kaunsi wajah hai ki yeh kafir teri naseehat aur dawat se munh pher rahe hain aur Quran-o-Hadith se is tarah bhag rahe hain jaise jangli gadhe shikari sher se, Farsi zaban mein jise sher kehte hain use Arabi mein Asad kehte hain aur Habshi zaban mein Q-Sorah kehte hain aur Nabti zaban mein Roya. 

Phir farmata hai yeh mushrikeen to chahte hain ki un mein ke har shakhs par alag alag kitab utre jaise aur jagah un ka maqoola hai: Hatta nu'ta mithla ma ootiya rusulullah (Al-An'am: 124), yaani jab un ke paas koi aayat aati hai to kehte hain ki hum to hargaz iman na laayenge jab tak ki woh na diye jayen jo Allah ke rasoolon ko diya gaya hai. Allah Ta'ala ko ba-khoobi ilm hai ki risalat ke qabil kaun hai? Aur yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ki hum baghair amal ke chhutkara diye jayen. 

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai darasal wajah yeh hai ki unhein aakhirat ka khauf hi nahi kyunki unhein is ka yaqeen nahi, is par iman nahi balki ise jhutlate hain to phir darte kyun? 

Phir farmaya sachi baat to yeh hai ki yeh Quran mahz naseehat-o-mau'izat hai jo chahe ibrat hasil kar le aur naseehat pakad le, jaise farmaan hai: Wa ma tasha'una illa an yasha'allahu Rabbul 'alameen (At-Takwir: 29), yaani tumhari chahatein Allah ki chahat ke tabeh hain.
